title: The Wreck of Mount Kessler
author: Gideon Thornbury
blurb: Gideon Vasquez, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
